∀ (k G : Type u) [inst : Field.{u} k] [IsAlgClosed.{u} k] [inst_2 : Group.{u} G] [inst_3 : Fintype.{u} G]
  [NeZero.{u} (Nat.cast.{u} (Nat.card.{u} G))],
  Exists.{1} fun n =>
    Exists.{u + 2} fun V =>
      Exists.{u + 1} fun ρ_end =>
        And (∀ (i : Fin n), CategoryTheory.Simple.{u, u + 1} (V i))
          (And (∀ (i j : Fin n), Nonempty.{u + 1} (CategoryTheory.Iso.{u, u + 1} (V i) (V j)) → Eq.{1} i j)
            (And
              (∀ (W : FDRep.{u, u} k G),
                CategoryTheory.Simple.{u, u + 1} W →
                  Exists.{1} fun i => Nonempty.{u + 1} (CategoryTheory.Iso.{u, u + 1} W (V i)))
              (And
                (∀ (g : G)
                  (F : (i : Fin n) → Module.End.{u, u} k (FGModuleCat.carrier.{u, u} (Action.V.{u, u + 1, u} (V i))))
                  (i : Fin n),
                  Eq.{u + 1} (DFunLike.coe.{u + 1, u + 1, u + 1} (DFunLike.coe.{u + 1, u + 1, u + 1} ρ_end g) F i)
                    (LinearMap.comp.{u, u, u, u, u, u} (DFunLike.coe.{u + 1, u + 1, u + 1} (FDRep.ρ.{u, u} (V i)) g)
                      (F i)))
                (Nonempty.{u + 1}
                  (CategoryTheory.Iso.{u, u + 1} (MonoidAlgebra.regularFDRep.{u} k G) (FDRep.of.{u, u} ρ_end))))))

{k G : Type u} →
  [inst : Field.{u} k] →
    [inst_1 : IsAlgClosed.{u} k] →
      [inst_2 : Group.{u} G] →
        [inst_3 : Fintype.{u} G] →
          [inst_4 : NeZero.{u} (Nat.cast.{u} (Nat.card.{u} G))] →
            (D : IrrepDecomp.{u, u} k G) →
              CategoryTheory.Iso.{u, u + 1} (MonoidAlgebra.regularFDRep.{u} k G) (IrrepDecomp.endRegFDRep.{u} D)
